🎤✨ Show: The Next Headliner

Two best friends enter the competition promising to support each other until the very end. They rehearse together, celebrate each other’s victories, and believe their friendship will survive anything.

But when both performers become serious contenders for the same prize, jealousy and ambition begin to threaten their bond. Suddenly, every performance feels personal, and only one can claim the spotlight.

Show: The Next Headliner explores what happens when chasing the same dream puts a friendship to the ultimate test.
